points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 海森堡出生于德国维尔茨堡，父亲是中学希腊语教师。1910年全家迁往慕尼黑，他在那里完成了中学教育。海森堡从小就展现出对数学和物理的浓厚兴趣，尤其热爱理论问题。1919-1920年，他曾短暂参与志愿工作，但很快回到学术道路。这段早期教育奠定了他严谨的科学思维和对物理学的热爱，为他后来的量子力学研究奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Heisenberg was born in Würzburg, Germany, to a secondary school teacher of Greek. His family moved to Munich in 1910, where he completed his secondary education. From an early age, Heisenberg showed a strong interest in mathematics and physics, particularly theoretical problems. In 1919-1920, he briefly participated in volunteer work but quickly returned to academic pursuits. This early education established his rigorous scientific thinking and love for physics, laying the foundation for his later quantum mechanics research.

points.title: 量子力学奠基
points.description: 海森堡在慕尼黑大学跟随阿诺德·索末菲学习理论物理，后前往哥廷根大学跟随马克斯·玻恩研究。1925年，他在赫尔戈兰岛度假期间提出了矩阵力学，这是量子力学的一种数学表述形式。1927年，他提出了著名的测不准原理，表明粒子的位置和动量不能同时被精确测量。这一时期的工作彻底改变了物理学的发展方向，使他成为量子力学的主要创始人之一。
points.descriptionEn: In Munich, Heisenberg studied theoretical physics under Arnold Sommerfeld, then moved to Göttingen University to research with Max Born. In 1925, during a holiday on Heligoland Island, he developed matrix mechanics, a mathematical formulation of quantum mechanics. In 1927, he formulated the uncertainty principle, stating that position and momentum of a particle cannot both be precisely measured simultaneously. This period's work revolutionized the direction of physics, establishing him as one of the principal founders of quantum mechanics.

points.title: 学术巅峰期
points.description: 1927年，海森堡成为莱比锡大学理论物理学教授，年仅26岁。在此期间，他发展了量子场论，提出了S矩阵理论，并完成了关于铁磁性的重要研究。他还培养了众多杰出的物理学家，包括德国核计划中的许多关键人物。1932年，他因创立量子力学而获得诺贝尔物理学奖。这一时期是海森堡学术生涯的巅峰，他的理论框架成为现代物理学的基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1927, Heisenberg became professor of theoretical physics at Leipzig University at just 26 years old. During this period, he developed quantum field theory, proposed S-matrix theory, and completed important research on ferromagnetism. He also mentored many prominent physicists, including key figures in the German nuclear program. In 1932, he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics for creating quantum mechanics. This period marked the peak of Heisenberg's academic career, with his theoretical framework becoming the foundation of modern physics.

points.title: 核能研究
points.description: 二战期间，海森堡被任命为柏林凯泽·威廉研究所物理部主任，领导德国核武器计划。尽管他后来声称故意拖延或阻碍了核武器的研发，历史学家对此仍有争议。1941年，他访问哥本哈根与尼尔斯·玻尔会面，讨论核能问题，这次会面成为两人关系的转折点。1945年，海森堡与德国其他核物理学家一起被美军俘虏，送往英国农场进行拘禁。这段经历使他的战后声誉受到质疑，也引发了他与玻尔之间的长期不和。
points.descriptionEn: During World War II, Heisenberg was appointed director of the Physics Department at the Kaiser Wilhelm Institute in Berlin, leading Germany's nuclear weapons program. Although he later claimed to have deliberately delayed or hindered nuclear weapon development, historians remain divided on this issue. In 1941, he visited Copenhagen to meet with Niels Bohr to discuss nuclear energy, a meeting that became a turning point in their relationship. In 1945, Heisenberg and other German nuclear physicists were captured by the US Army and interned at Farm Hall in England. This experience led to questions about his post-war reputation and caused a long-standing rift with Bohr.

points.title: 战后重建
points.description: 战后，海森堡回到慕尼黑，帮助重建德国科学界。他担任马克斯·普朗克物理研究所所长，并成为国际科学界的重要人物。他积极参与国际科学合作，推动和平利用原子能，并担任了联合国原子能咨询委员会主席。海森堡还致力于科学哲学研究，探讨了量子力学中的认识论问题。1976年，海森堡在慕尼黑逝世，他的理论遗产和科学哲学思想继续影响着现代物理学和科学哲学的发展。
points.descriptionEn: After the war, Heisenberg returned to Munich and helped rebuild German science. He served as director of the Max Planck Institute for Physics and became an important figure in the international scientific community. He actively participated in international scientific cooperation, promoting the peaceful use of atomic energy, and served as chairman of the United Nations Advisory Committee on Atomic Energy. Heisenberg also engaged in the philosophy of science, exploring epistemological issues in quantum mechanics. In 1976, Heisenberg died in Munich, and his theoretical legacy and philosophical ideas continue to influence modern physics and the philosophy of science.

appraisal.zh: 海森堡是20世纪最重要的物理学家之一，其量子力学与测不准原理不仅重塑了微观世界的图景，也深刻影响了哲学认识论，战后还推动原子能的和平利用。不过，他在二战期间参与德国核计划一事始终是争议焦点：他自称有意拖延，也有研究者指出德国计划本身存在技术缺陷，其战后辩解亦被视为自我辩护，1941年与玻尔的会面同样留下模糊解读。科学上的天才与政治动荡中的道德困境，在他身上并存。
appraisal.en: Heisenberg ranks among the most important physicists of the twentieth century: quantum mechanics and the uncertainty principle reshaped the microscopic world and left a deep mark on philosophy, and after the war he promoted the peaceful use of atomic energy. Yet his role in Germany's wartime nuclear program remains contested. He claimed to have delayed it, while other researchers point to technical deficiencies in the program itself and regard his postwar accounts as self-defense; his 1941 meeting with Bohr also remains ambiguous. Scientific genius and moral dilemma under political turmoil coexist in him.

supporter.zh: 海森堡是20世纪最伟大的物理学家之一，他的量子力学理论彻底改变了人类对微观世界的理解。测不准原理不仅是物理学的基础，也深刻影响了哲学和认识论。作为量子力学的创始人，他的贡献堪比爱因斯坦的相对论。战后，他积极推动和平利用原子能，体现了科学家的社会责任感。他的科学哲学思想强调观察者与被观察系统的关系，为现代科学认识论提供了重要视角。
supporter.en: Heisenberg stands as one of the greatest physicists of the 20th century, whose quantum mechanics theory revolutionized our understanding of the microscopic world. The uncertainty principle not only forms the foundation of physics but also profoundly influenced philosophy and epistemology. As a founder of quantum mechanics, his contributions are comparable to Einstein's theory of relativity. After the war, he actively promoted the peaceful use of atomic energy, demonstrating the social responsibility of scientists. His philosophical ideas emphasizing the relationship between observer and observed system provide crucial perspectives for modern scientific epistemology.

critic.zh: 海森堡在二战期间参与德国核武器计划的行为备受争议。他声称故意拖延或阻碍了核武器的研发，但历史证据表明德国核计划本身存在技术缺陷，而非他的道德抵抗。他与玻尔在1941年的会面中，关于核能的模糊表述被解读为对纳粹政权的默许。此外，他在战后对自身角色的辩解被批评为自我辩护而非真实历史。这些争议使他在科学道德和科学家的社会责任方面留下了复杂的历史评价。
critic.en: Heisenberg's involvement in Germany's nuclear weapons program during World War II remains controversial. While he claimed to deliberately delay or hinder nuclear weapon development, historical evidence suggests the German nuclear program had technical deficiencies rather than his moral resistance. His ambiguous statements about nuclear energy during his 1941 meeting with Bohr have been interpreted as tacit acceptance of the Nazi regime. Furthermore, his post-war justifications of his role have been criticized as self-defense rather than historical truth. These controversies leave a complex historical evaluation of him regarding scientific ethics and the social responsibility of scientists.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，海森堡常被描绘为典型的'天才与道德困境'的复杂人物。他的科学成就无可争议，但战争经历使他的形象充满矛盾。流行文化中，他既是量子力学的天才创立者，又是战争时期道德立场模糊的科学家。他的测不准原理已成为超越物理学领域的文化符号，象征着认知的局限性和观察者效应。在科学史上，他代表了20世纪物理学革命的核心人物，同时也体现了科学家在政治动荡中的道德抉择困境。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Heisenberg is often portrayed as a complex figure embodying the 'genius with moral dilemma' archetype. His scientific achievements are undisputed, but his war experiences have created a contradictory image. In popular culture, he is depicted both as the brilliant creator of quantum mechanics and as a scientist with ambiguous moral positions during wartime. His uncertainty principle has transcended physics to become a cultural symbol, representing the limitations of knowledge and the observer effect. In scientific history, he represents a central figure in the 20th-century physics revolution while also illustrating the moral dilemmas scientists face during political turmoil.

self.zh: 自然不包含我们称之为'自然'的客观实在，它只包含我们能够通过实验和测量所描述的关系。
self.en: What we observe is not nature itself, but nature exposed to our method of questioning.
